mapper.select: SELECT outpatient_volume FROM stat_health_svc_metric order by stat_time limit 1

SELECT date, outpatient_volume AS value FROM ( SELECT DATE(stat_time) AS date, outpatient_volume, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY DATE(stat_time) ORDER BY stat_time DESC) AS rn FROM stat_health_svc_metric WHERE stat_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 29 DAY) ) t WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY date ASC
